messages:
sam: Quick proposal — new runtime API for temporary config overrides (pin/route/budget tweaks) with TTL + lock token + telemetry contract. Sketch below and safety ideas.

sam: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/runtime/overrides
{
  "route": "/v1/text/generate",
  "changes": {"model": "redwood-2.1-quant", "batching.enabled": false},
  "ttl_seconds": 300,
  "max_traffic_pct": 10,
  "owner": "sam",
  "reason": "hotfix: quant regression in prod"
}
Response:
{"override_id": "ovr_123", "lock_token": "tok_abcd", "expires_at": 1769991534}
```

claire: Love the shape. Questions: who can create these? need approval flow for >X% traffic? also audit metadata required.

kev: +1. Strongly require automatic safety triggers: if error_rate > 2x baseline for 5m or p95 latency spikes > 300ms, revert. Also quota/budget protection so overrides can't blow monthly commit.

maria: Console side: we need a forecast in the UI — predicted token delta and cost impact for the TTL window, plus an option to dry-run (audit-only) that simulates routing without touching traffic.

sam: Agreed. Propose events: `override.created`, `override.extended`, `override.reverted`, `override.expired`. Telemetry contract: baseline windows (1h/24h), signals: error_rate, median_latency, p95_latency, cost_per_token, tokens_per_minute.

kev: API nit: return `lock_token` so callers can extend or explicitly rollback. Include `if-match` style idempotency/version to avoid races. Also add `auto_revert_policy` field: `{"metric": "error_rate", "threshold_ratio": 2.0, "window_seconds": 300}`

claire: Security: RBAC scope `runtime.override.create` + require `owner` and `ticket` (JIRA link). Retention: audit logs kept 1 year, console activity 30 days by default.

ops-bot: CONFIG_OVERLAY applied by sam at 1769991234 (dry-run simulated).

maria: For the UI mock I'm adding `predicted_token_delta` and `delta_confidence` fields. Also we should surface which quota pools will be impacted and whether reserve capacity exists.

kev: Suggest adding `circuit_breaker`: if `budget_spend_rate` > X% of forecast, auto-disable override and send page. Also allow scoped max spend override only with special approval.

claire: One more — TTL granularity: do we want seconds? minutes? seconds fine but validate limits (min 30s, max 24h). Also expose ability to extend with the lock token.

sam: Will draft an RFC + API PR with example telemetry dashboards and console wire tomorrow. Can everyone thumbs if they agree on the safety triggers and fields above?

maria: :thumbsup: I can mock the forecast tile and quota impact panel.

kev: :+1: Add text about rate limits on how many overrides per-route per-hour to avoid churn.

claire: :thumbsup: I want `revert_reason` mandatory when manual revert happens.

sam: Great — I'll include: lock_token, ttl_seconds, max_traffic_pct, auto_revert_policy, circuit_breaker config, dry_run flag, and audit retention policy. Opening RFC tomorrow AM.

maria: Sounds good. If no objections by EOD, we'll proceed with console wire and API stub.

kev: Quick follow-up: add metric `success_ratio` (1 - error_rate) to make thresholding clearer.

sam: Noted. Thanks all.
